bio.text: Brian Babin represents Texas's 36th Congressional District and was sworn into the 114th Congress on January 5, 2015.
Born in Port Arthur and raised in Beaumont, he earned a bachelor's degree from Lamar University and completed dental school at the University of Texas Dental Branch in Houston.
He served in the Texas Army National Guard and as a captain in the U.S. Air Force, then ran a dental practice in Woodville for over 30 years.
He has served as mayor of Woodville, a city councilman and a school board member.
